plugin.name: STTNG
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Solves the shuffling Prosper 201 pk maze and walks you to any room in it

muclient.script:
require "aardwolf_colors" require "gmcphelper"
local GMCP_ID = "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264"
-- =========================================================== -- The section -- -- Prosper's Island, the level 201 pk "Star Trek" wing above -- The Imaginarium (lemdagor 2010). Eleven maze rooms plus the -- entry room and four side rooms reached by going up. -- -- The maze reshuffles on every repop, so NONE of the links -- between these rooms are hardcoded - the plugin learns them -- by walking, and throws the lot away the moment a link it -- already knew turns out to lead somewhere else. -- ===========================================================
local IMAGINARIUM = 2010 -- lemdagor room below the section; "up" enters local ENTRY = 28256 -- Entering the Theater
-- Menu order. Side rooms first - they are the ones worth walking to. local ROOMS = { {28264, "In Stalwart's Room"}, {28265, "In Brawn's Room"}, {28267, "In Moriarty's Room"}, {28266, "At 'The Bridge'?"}, {28256, "Entering the Theater"}, {28252, "On a Tribune"}, {28253, "Standing in Line"}, {28254, "Intruding upon 'Act I, Scene II'"}, {28255, "Behind the Stage"}, {28257, "The Play is the Thing"}, {28258, "A Dressing Room"}, {28259, "Behind the Stage"}, {28260, "On 'The Bridge'"}, {28261, "A Storage Room"}, {28262, "Behind the Stage"}, {28263, "A Dark Room"}, }
-- The four rooms you reach by going up out of the maze. local SIDE = { [28264] = true, [28265] = true, [28266] = true, [28267] = true }
local NAME = {} local ENTRY_INDEX for i, r in ipairs (ROOMS) do NAME[r[1]] = r[2] if r[1] == ENTRY then ENTRY_INDEX = i end end
local DIRS = { "n", "e", "s", "w", "u", "d" }
-- =========================================================== -- Output (x099 brackets / x045 name / white text / x048 values) -- ===========================================================
local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" local CLR_HI = "#00FF87"
local function cnote (s) AnsiNote (stylesToANSI (ColoursToStyles (s))) end
local function note (msg) cnote ("@x099[@x045STTNG@x099]@w " .. msg) end
local function warn (msg) cnote ("@x099[@x045STTNG@x099]@w @x203" .. msg .. "@w") end
-- =========================================================== -- Learned map -- -- edges[from][dir] = to 0 = leads out of the section -- -1 = "Alas, you cannot go that way" -- both mean "never try this again" -- exits[from][dir] = true directions the room actually has, -- read straight off GMCP room.info -- ===========================================================
local edges, exits = {}, {} local cur = nil -- vnum we are standing in, per GMCP
local show_menu -- defined down in the commands section; the GMCP -- handler above it needs to be able to call it
local DATA_FILE = GetPluginInfo (GetPluginID (), 20) .. "STTNG.dat"
local function seed () -- The only link we can safely assume: down out of the entry room -- drops you back into The Imaginarium. Marking it "out" stops the -- solver from ever walking itself out of the section. edges[ENTRY] = edges[ENTRY] or {} edges[ENTRY]["d"] = 0 end
local function save_map () local f = io.open (DATA_FILE, "w") if not f then return end f:write ("-- STTNG learned map. Written by the plugin; safe to delete.\n") f:write ("return {\n edges = {\n") for from, t in pairs (edges) do local parts = {} for d, to in pairs (t) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format ("[%q]=%d", d, to) end f:write (string.format (" [%d]={%s},\n", from, table.concat (parts, ","))) end f:write (" },\n exits = {\n") for from, t in pairs (exits) do local parts = {} for d in pairs (t) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format ("[%q]=true", d) end f:write (string.format (" [%d]={%s},\n", from, table.concat (parts, ","))) end f:write (" },\n}\n") f:close () end
local function load_map () edges, exits = {}, {} local f = io.open (DATA_FILE, "r") if f then local body = f:read ("*a") f:close () local chunk = loadstring (body or "") if chunk then local ok, t = pcall (chunk) if ok and type (t) == "table" then edges = t.edges or {} exits = t.exits or {} end end end seed () end
local function known_links () local n = 0 for _, t in pairs (edges) do for _, to in pairs (t) do if to > 0 then n = n + 1 end end end return n end
-- Read the room we are standing in straight out of GMCP. Needed as -- well as the broadcast handler: right after a reload nothing has -- been broadcast yet, so without this the solver would not even know -- which directions the current room offers. local function absorb_room () local ri = gmcp ("room.info") if type (ri) ~= "table" then return end local num = tonumber (ri.num) if not num then return end cur = num if not NAME[num] then return end local e = {} if type (ri.exits) == "table" then for d in pairs (ri.exits) do e[d] = true end end -- Belt and braces: if GMCP hands us a room in the section with no -- exit list at all, assume all six and let the blocked-exit trigger -- rule the impossible ones out. if next (e) == nil then for _, d in ipairs (DIRS) do e[d] = true end end exits[num] = e end
-- =========================================================== -- Walk state -- ===========================================================
local walking = false local phase = nil -- "travel" (to 2010), "enter" (up), "solve" local target = nil local pending = nil -- { from = vnum, dir = "n" } local gen = 0 -- bumped on every stop, so stale timers die local steps = 0 local retried = false local leaving = false -- sttngout: drop out of the theater on arrival
local MAXSTEPS = 90
local function stop (msg, bad) walking = false phase = nil pending = nil target = nil gen = gen + 1 save_map () if msg then if bad then warn (msg) else note (msg) end end end
-- =========================================================== -- Pathfinding over what we have actually learned -- ===========================================================
-- Breadth-first over known links. goalfn(vnum) says when to stop. -- Returns the list of directions to walk, or nil. local function bfs (from, goalfn) if goalfn (from) then return {} end local seen = { [from] = true } local back = {} local q, head = { from }, 1 while head <= #q do local r = q[head] head = head + 1 local t = edges[r] if t then for _, d in ipairs (DIRS) do local to = t[d] if to and to > 0 and not seen[to] then seen[to] = true back[to] = { r, d } if goalfn (to) then local path, n = {}, to while n ~= from do local p = back[n] table.insert (path, 1, p[2]) n = p[1] end return path end q[#q + 1] = to end end end end return nil end
-- Which direction should we try first when guessing? If we are -- hunting a side room, "up" is the move that finds one, so try it -- first. Otherwise up is a two-move detour, so try it last. local function order () if target and SIDE[target] then return { "u", "n", "e", "s", "w", "d" } end return { "n", "e", "s", "w", "d", "u" } end
-- An exit out of this room we have never taken. local function untried (r) local ex = exits[r] if not ex then return nil end local kn = edges[r] for _, d in ipairs (order ()) do if ex[d] and not (kn and kn[d]) then return d end end return nil end
local function next_dir () if cur == target then return nil, "arrived" end
local path = bfs (cur, function (v) return v == target end) if path and path[1] then return path[1] end
local d = untried (cur) if d then return d end
path = bfs (cur, function (v) return untried (v) ~= nil end) if path and path[1] then return path[1] end
return nil, "stuck" end
-- =========================================================== -- Walking -- ===========================================================
local function move (dir) steps = steps + 1 if steps > MAXSTEPS then stop ("Gave up after " .. MAXSTEPS .. " moves without finding it.", true) return end pending = { from = cur, dir = dir } retried = false Send (dir) DoAfterSpecial (4, "pm_timeout (" .. gen .. ")", 12) end
-- sttngout: we are standing in the entry room, so step down into -- The Imaginarium and we are clear of the section. local function drop_out () leaving = false note ("Out through @x048The Imaginarium@w.") Send ("d") end
local function advance () local dir, why = next_dir () if dir then move (dir) return end if why == "arrived" then if leaving then stop () drop_out () return end stop ("Arrived: @x048" .. (NAME[cur] or cur) .. "@w (@x048" .. cur .. "@w)") else stop ("No unexplored exits left and I still cannot reach that room. " .. "Try @x048sttng reset@w and run it again.", true) end end
-- The maze reshuffled under us: everything we knew is now wrong. -- absorb_room puts the exit list for the room we are standing in -- straight back, otherwise the solver wakes up blind and gives up. local function reshuffled () edges, exits = {}, {} seed () absorb_room () warn ("The maze has reshuffled - throwing the old map away and solving again.") end
-- Record what we just learned by moving. local function record (from, dir, to) edges[from] = edges[from] or {} local old = edges[from][dir] if old and old ~= to then reshuffled () edges[from] = edges[from] or {} end edges[from][dir] = to end
-- =========================================================== -- Timeout guard -- ===========================================================
function pm_timeout (g) if not walking or g ~= gen or not pending then return end if not retried then retried = true Send (pending.dir) DoAfterSpecial (4, "pm_timeout (" .. gen .. ")", 12) return end if phase == "travel" then stop ("The mapper did not get me to The Imaginarium. Walk there yourself " .. "and run @x048sttng@w again.", true) else stop ("No response to '@x048" .. pending.dir .. "@w' - something is holding " .. "me in place. Stopped.", true) end end
-- The move bounced off a wall. GMCP listed the direction but the -- game will not let us through it, so cross it off and pick again -- instead of sitting out the four second timeout. function pm_blocked () if not walking or phase ~= "solve" or not pending then return end local from, dir = pending.from, pending.dir pending = nil gen = gen + 1 -- the timer for that move is now stale edges[from] = edges[from] or {} edges[from][dir] = -1 advance () end
-- =========================================================== -- GMCP -- ===========================================================
function OnPluginBroadcast (msg, id, bname, text) if id ~= GMCP_ID then return end
if text == "char.status" then if not walking then return end local st = gmcp ("char.status") if type (st) ~= "table" then return end if tonumber (st.state) == 8 then stop ("In combat - walk stopped. @x048sttng@w again when you are clear.", true) end return end
if text ~= "room.info" then return end
local ri = gmcp ("room.info") if type (ri) ~= "table" then return end
local num = tonumber (ri.num) if not num then return end
-- Remember which directions this room offers. Inside a maze GMCP -- gives the directions but not where they lead, which is exactly -- the half we need. local was = cur absorb_room ()
-- Walked up into the theater from outside: put the list up unasked. -- Only from outside, so passing through it mid-walk stays quiet. if num == ENTRY and not NAME[was] and not walking then show_menu () end
if not walking then return end
-- Waiting for the mapper to deliver us to The Imaginarium. if phase == "travel" then if num == IMAGINARIUM then phase = "enter" pending = { from = IMAGINARIUM, dir = "u" } retried = false Send ("u") DoAfterSpecial (4, "pm_timeout (" .. gen .. ")", 12) end return end
if phase == "enter" then if NAME[num] then phase = "solve" pending = nil advance () end return end
if phase ~= "solve" or not pending then return end
-- Any room.info while a move is outstanding IS the result of that -- move. Note we do not skip num == pending.from: a shuffled maze -- can perfectly well loop an exit back into the room you left, and -- treating that as "no move" would stall the walk for good. local from, dir = pending.from, pending.dir pending = nil
-- Walked out of the section. if not NAME[num] then record (from, dir, 0) if num == IMAGINARIUM then note ("That exit drops out to The Imaginarium - noted, going back up.") phase = "enter" pending = { from = IMAGINARIUM, dir = "u" } retried = false Send ("u") DoAfterSpecial (4, "pm_timeout (" .. gen .. ")", 12) else stop ("Left the section (now in room " .. num .. ") - stopped.", true) end return end
record (from, dir, num) advance () end
-- =========================================================== -- Commands -- ===========================================================
function show_menu () note ("Prosper 201 - click a room to walk to it:") for i, r in ipairs (ROOMS) do local vnum, rname = r[1], r[2] local hint = "Walk to " .. rname .. " (" .. vnum .. ")" ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("sttng go " .. i, string.format ("%2d", i), hint, CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("sttng go " .. i, rname, hint, SIDE[vnum] and CLR_NAME or CLR_MSG, "black", 0, 1) ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", string.rep (" ", math.max (1, 34 - #rname))) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "(" .. vnum .. ")" .. (cur == vnum and " <- you are here" or "")) end ColourTell (CLR_TAG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("sttngout", "sttngout", "Walk back to Entering the Theater and go down", CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " - back to the entrance and out through The Imaginarium") ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " " .. known_links () .. " links learned so far. sttng3 works too. stop / map / reset / help") end
local function go (n, want_out) local r = ROOMS[n] if not r then warn ("There is no room " .. tostring (n) .. " on the list. Type @x048sttng@w.") return end
if walking then stop () end
absorb_room ()
target = r[1] steps = 0 gen = gen + 1 walking = true pending = nil leaving = want_out and true or false
if leaving then note ("Heading out - back to @x048" .. r[2] .. "@w, then down.") else note ("Heading for @x048" .. r[2] .. "@w (@x048" .. r[1] .. "@w).") end
if cur == target then if leaving then stop () drop_out () else stop ("You are already standing in it.") end return end
if NAME[cur] then phase = "solve" advance () elseif cur == IMAGINARIUM then phase = "enter" pending = { from = IMAGINARIUM, dir = "u" } retried = false Send ("u") DoAfterSpecial (4, "pm_timeout (" .. gen .. ")", 12) else phase = "travel" note ("Not in the section - sending you to The Imaginarium first.") Execute ("mapper goto " .. IMAGINARIUM) DoAfterSpecial (4, "pm_timeout (" .. gen .. ")", 12) end end
local function show_map () note ("Learned links (" .. known_links () .. "):") for _, r in ipairs (ROOMS) do local from = r[1] local t = edges[from] if t then local parts = {} for _, d in ipairs (DIRS) do local to = t[d] if to == 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = d .. "->out" elseif to == -1 then parts[#parts + 1] = d .. "->wall" elseif to then parts[#parts + 1] = d .. "->" .. to end end if #parts > 0 then ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", " " .. from .. " ", CLR_MSG, "", string.format ("%-34s", r[2]), CLR_HI, "", table.concat (parts, " ")) end end end end
local function show_help () local lines = { "sttng - the clickable room list", "sttng <n> - walk to room <n> on that list", "sttng<n> - same thing, no space: sttng3", "sttngout - walk back to Entering the Theater and go down,", " which drops you out into The Imaginarium", "sttng stop - stop the current walk", "sttng map - show the links learned so far", "sttng reset - forget the map and solve from scratch", "", "The maze reshuffles every repop. You do not have to tell it - the", "moment a link it already knew leads somewhere else, it wipes what", "it had and starts solving again. It picks up from wherever you are", "standing, inside the maze or out.", } note ("Prosper 201 maze solver") for _, l in ipairs (lines) do ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " " .. l) end end
function pm_out () absorb_room () if not NAME[cur] then note ("You are not in the section - nothing to walk out of.") return end go (ENTRY_INDEX, true) end
function pm_command (name, line, wildcards) local arg = (wildcards[1] or ""):gsub ("^%s+", ""):gsub ("%s+$", "")
if arg == "" then show_menu () return end
local n = tonumber (arg:match ("^go%s+(%d+)$") or arg:match ("^(%d+)$")) if n then go (n) return end
if arg == "out" then pm_out () elseif arg == "stop" then if walking then stop ("Stopped.") else note ("Not walking.") end elseif arg == "map" then show_map () elseif arg == "reset" then stop () edges, exits = {}, {} seed () save_map () note ("Map forgotten. The next walk will solve the maze from scratch.") elseif arg == "help" then show_help () else warn ("Don't know '@x048" .. arg .. "@w'. Try @x048sttng help@w.") end end
-- ===========================================================
function OnPluginInstall () load_map () absorb_room () note ("Loaded. Type @x048sttng@w for the room list. " .. known_links () .. " links remembered.") end
function OnPluginClose () save_map () end
function OnPluginDisable () stop () end
